content:
customer_acme_billing: Hi team — our AWS Marketplace invoice for March is ~40% higher than what the Redwood dashboard shows. Line items report 1,215,000 units billed while our dashboard CSV shows 820,400 tokens. CFO wants an explanation. Invoice attached: https://s3.amazonaws.com/acme-billing/march-invoice.csv

maria: Thanks — sorry about that. Can you attach the invoice CSV line items and the Redwood usage export (CSV) for the same window? Also paste the AWS subscription ARN or Marketplace product ID you see on the invoice.

customer_acme_billing: Uploaded both to our S3: s3://acme-billing/mar/invoice.csv and s3://acme-billing/mar/redwood-usage.csv. AWS product: arn:aws:marketplace:us-east-1::product/5cdf-xxxxx.

kevin: Pulling the marketplace metering report now. Quick note: AWS Marketplace reports "units" and some of our adapters send 'units' representing 1k-token blocks; a unit mismatch or wrong dimension mapping could inflate charges. Running: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-billing-reports/marketplace/2026-03-meters.csv - | head -n 30`

billing-bot: Metering report generated: s3://redwood-billing-forwarding/marketplace/2026-03-10-report.csv (checksum available).

kevin: Quick diff between exports shows the big delta concentrated on rows where AWS dimension `CustomerReference` is `acct-9zxx` instead of our `tenant_id`. Example bad line from marketplace export:

```
2026-03-05,acct-9zxx,product/5cdf-xxxxx,100000
```

And our Redwood usage export line for the same time shows:

```
2026-03-05,tenant_id=acme-123,endpoint=embeddings,82000
```

alex: FWIW, I dug into the metering adapter and found a deploy on 2026-03-10 that changed the metering dimension key from `tenant_id` -> `customerRef` to support reseller flows. The adapter also switched metric units for embedding calls from `tokens` -> `requests` (we accidentally multiplied requests by 1000 when building the marketplace 'units'). That explains the ~1.2x–1.5x discrepancy on embedding-heavy customers.

maria: Can you outline repro steps and a minimal example so we can show acme exactly what went wrong? We need to offer a provisional credit ASAP while we investigate root cause.

kevin: Repro steps I used (local):

1) export sample usage:
```
# simulate export
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-15&tenant=acme-123" > local-usage.csv
```
2) fetch marketplace metering file:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-billing-forwarding/marketplace/2026-03-meters.csv ./meters.csv
```
3) run quick join by date and product to compare units -> tokens
```
python reconcile.py --usage local-usage.csv --meters meters.csv --key tenant_map.csv
```
Small snippet of the join output shows: `market_units=100000` vs `redwood_tokens=82000` for 2026-03-05.

kevin: Root cause summary: adapter deployed on 2026-03-10 changed the dimension name and unit semantics. Marketplace accepted the metering records but with the external account ref so AWS billed the reseller account units which are larger.

maria: Proposed remediation for acme: 1) Issue provisional credit equal to the delta (approx 394,600 tokens priced per contract) 2) Backfill corrected metering records to AWS Marketplace with proper `tenant_id` dimension and correct unit conversion, 3) Patch the adapter to restore `tenant_id` and add an integration test to detect unit mismatches, 4) Provide a post-mortem and exact timeline. Agree? :thumbsup:

customer_acme_billing: That sounds good. Please confirm credit timeline and whether we need to open a dispute with AWS.

kevin: I'll open internal billing ticket BILL-4782 and request a provisional credit today. For AWS dispute: we'll file if AWS marketplace refuses backfill. We can backfill using AWS Marketplace Metering Service APIs — script ready to run once we have confirmed corrected CSV. ETA: 48 hours to backfill + deploy patch to prevent recurrence.

sre-oncall: Noted. Creating monitoring alert for metering dimension drift and adding a smoke test for marketplace reconciliation in CI. @kevin please add the new alert to the runbook.

maria: I'll send acme a summary and the provisional credit confirmation once BILL-4782 has an owner and amount. Will update this thread when credit is posted.

kevin: Owner assigned, posting credit today, patch scheduled for next deploy (2026-03-12). I'll attach the reconciled CSV and backfill logs here once complete.

customer_acme_billing: Appreciate the rapid response. Please keep this thread updated and cc our billing contact: billing@acme.co.

maria: Thanks all — temporary credit issued, next updates here. :white_check_mark:
